summary: Master credit and debt management with our comprehensive course. Learn effective strategies for managing accounts receivables and improving financial health.
lede: Credit management and accounts receivable training covers assessing customer credit risk and managing payments from invoicing through collection. It is for finance, sales, operations and other professionals involved in credit decisions or payment follow-up, helping them set credit terms, interpret aging reports, prioritize collections, address disputed accounts and forecast cash flow.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals who manage, monitor, or influence credit and collections processes:
audience: Accounts receivable officers and finance assistants
modules: Preventing Bad Debt and Credit Losses
